status.label: Questionable
status.longComment: Brooks was held out of practice for a second straight day, and his consecutive absences could put his availability in jeopardy for Sunday's game against the Bears. Perhaps out of concern for Brooks' status heading into the weekend, the Packers signed Pierre Strong off their practice squad Thursday to give the team another healthy option in the backfield behind MarShawn Lloyd and Kaleb Johnson. If Brooks ends up sitting out Sunday, Strong could end up handling some of Brooks' responsibilities on passing downs.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Williams (ankle) was a limited participant Wednesday after the Packers opened his 21-day practice window.
status.longComment: Williams sustained a high-ankle sprain late in training camp, prompting the Packers to place the second-year wide receiver on injured reserve. After sitting out the team's first four games, Williams is ready to mix back into drills, but he'll likely need to practice fully Thursday and Friday in order to have a shot at returning from IR and suiting up this Sunday against the Bears. Once activated, Williams will likely be a factor in the return game and could push Skyy Moore for the No. 3 receiver role behind Christian Watson and Matthew Golden.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Banks (toe/knee) did not participate at practice Thursday.
status.longComment: Banks has sat out the Packers' last two games with toe and knee injuries, and his availability for Week 5 is now also in serious doubt. Unless he's able to practice in some capacity Friday, he'll probably be on track to be sidelined Sunday versus the Bears.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Burton (back) was a limited participant at practice Thursday.
status.longComment: Burton did not practice Wednesday, so his activity Thursday was actually a step in the right direction ahead of Sunday's game versus the Bears. If he can upgrade to full participation at practice Friday, he may still be able to avoid carrying an injury designation into the weekend.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Monk (quadriceps) did not participate at the Packers' practice Thursday.
status.longComment: Monk has missed back-to-back practices to open the week as he continues to recover from a quadriceps injury he suffered during the team's Week 3 loss to Atlanta. The 25-year-old appears to be set to miss a second straight game, and Travis Glover could draw another start at left guard Sunday versus Chicago.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Belton (knee) was a limited participant at practice Thursday.
status.longComment: Belton played all 60 of the Packers' offensive snaps in Week 4 at Tampa Bay, but his status for Week 5 now seems to be in question due to a knee issue. He'll likely need to log a full practice Friday to avoid carrying an injury designation into the weekend.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Green Bay placed Brinson (calf/groin) on injured reserve Saturday.
status.longComment: Brinson hurt his calf during the preseason and didn't suit up for the Packers' first three games. He logged a limited practice Wednesday but slipped and injured his groin, per Matt Schneidman of The Athletic, and was then a DNP both Thursday and Friday. Though Brinson's placement on IR means the Packers now have an open roster spot, they didn't add anyone to the active roster or elevate any players ahead of Sunday's game versus Tampa Bay, so they'll enter that contest with a 52-man roster.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Van Ness (shoulder) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.
status.longComment: Van Ness was limited in all three practices building up to the Packers' Week 4 win over the Buccaneers. The linebacker entered the contest without an injury designation, logging 73 percent of the team's defensive snaps in the win. Van Ness appears set to duplicate last week's schedule, likely logging limited practices throughout the week and avoiding any injury designation for Sunday's game against the Bears.

status.label: PUP
status.shortComment: Parsons (knee), per head coach Matt LaFleur, will not practice this week, Weston Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.
status.longComment: With four weeks in the books, Parsons now is eligible to be activated from the reserve/PUP list, but with him not yet ready to practice he will not return to action in Week 5 against the Bears, and it may be tough for him to make it back for Green Bay's Week 6 matchup against his former Dallas team.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Cooper (Achilles) was placed on injured reserve by the Packers on Tuesday.
status.longComment: Cooper suffered a torn Achilles in Sunday's win over the Buccaneers, and he will now spend the rest of the season on IR. In his absence, Zaire Franklin and Isaiah McDuffie will operate as the team's primary options at inside linebacker.
